verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs confirm channels as the organizing unit for conversations and describe subscription-based access, with doc-22 distinguishing that 'everyone other than guests can subscribe to any public or web-public channel' (implying private channels have restricted membership), and doc-27 shows subscription controls affecting notifications. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of private channel creation, invite-only membership workflows, or admin-level permission settings for channels, and community comment (zulip-comm-8) notes a wish for 'better admin and audit tools,' suggesting admin controls are less mature. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on private channel creation/invite flows, explicit admin permission settings for channel membership, and independent confirmation of robust admin-side channel governance.
